tileColumns.description: Number of tile columns in the shatter grid.

tileRows.description: Number of tile rows in the shatter grid.

color.description: CSS color for the tile fill and reveal background.

incomingImageSrc.description: Optional image path revealed behind the shattered tiles.

spreadFactor.description: Multiplier for how far tiles travel when shattering (1.0 = moderate, 2.0 = dramatic).
